title: Ikoro (standing log slit drum)
summary: A tall hollowed log stands upright in a forest clearing. A slit runs down its length; the thick lip booms and the thin lip rings higher. Its beat was once carried from village to village as a message.
howToPlay: Four places are lit: Thick lip, Thin lip, Bark and Top.
Strike the place a closing ring marks.
Keep the call steady and let the answer follow.
rules: A stroke on the beat is perfect, a near one is good, and extra strokes cost points.
The round ends when the last stroke has been judged; the score is the share of the best possible.
heritageNote: A great log drum could be heard far across the forest, so its rhythms carried news between communities.
credits: Tradition: the large carved log drum of the Igbo; patterns written for this game
